title: Ali's Middle Eastern Samosas
description: A traditional Indian snack filled with spiced potatoes and peas, wrapped in a flaky pastry.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a pan, sauté the onion, ginger, and garlic until softened.
Add the potatoes, peas, and spice mix to the pan and cook until the potatoes are tender.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of pastry using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the potato mixture onto the center of each pastry circle.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water and fold the pastry in half to form a triangle.
Seal the edges by pressing with a fork and press the edges together to seal the samosa.
Fry the samosas in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the samosas on paper towels and serve hot.
